CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_pending_fee_estimates()
 RETURNS TABLE(seller_sku text, listing_price numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  SELECT DISTINCT dss.seller_sku::text, foi.item_price_amount::numeric
  FROM fact_order_item foi
  LEFT JOIN dim_seller_sku dss ON foi.seller_sku_id = dss.id
  WHERE dss.seller_sku IS NOT NULL
    AND foi.item_price_amount IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM marketplace_fee_estimates mfe
      WHERE mfe.seller_sku = dss.seller_sku
        AND mfe.listing_price = foi.item_price_amount
        AND mfe.status = 'success'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.load_fact_order()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    rows_processed INTEGER;
BEGIN

    INSERT INTO fact_order
    (
        amazon_order_id,
        marketplace_id,

        purchase_date,
        order_date,
        last_update_date,

        order_status,

        fulfillment_channel,
        sales_channel,

        order_total_amount,
        order_total_currency,

        number_of_items_shipped,
        number_of_items_unshipped,

        is_business_order,

        source_system,
        source_created_at,

        created_at,
        updated_at
    )

    SELECT

        amazon_order_id,
        marketplace_id,

        purchase_date,
        purchase_date::DATE,
        last_update_date,

        order_status,

        fulfillment_channel,
        sales_channel,

        order_total_amount,
        order_total_currency,

        number_of_items_shipped,
        number_of_items_unshipped,

        is_business_order,

        'AMAZON_SP_API',
        extraction_date,

        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

    FROM stg_orders_amazon

    WHERE processed = FALSE


    ON CONFLICT (amazon_order_id)

    DO UPDATE SET

        order_status = EXCLUDED.order_status,

        last_update_date = EXCLUDED.last_update_date,

        fulfillment_channel =
            EXCLUDED.fulfillment_channel,

        sales_channel =
            EXCLUDED.sales_channel,

        order_total_amount =
            EXCLUDED.order_total_amount,

        order_total_currency =
            EXCLUDED.order_total_currency,

        number_of_items_shipped =
            EXCLUDED.number_of_items_shipped,

        number_of_items_unshipped =
            EXCLUDED.number_of_items_unshipped,

        is_business_order =
            EXCLUDED.is_business_order,

        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;


    GET DIAGNOSTICS rows_processed = ROW_COUNT;


    UPDATE stg_orders_amazon

    SET
        processed = TRUE,
        processed_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

    WHERE processed = FALSE;


    RETURN rows_processed;

END;
$function$

name: load_fact_order_item

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.load_fact_order_item()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    rows_processed INTEGER;
BEGIN

    INSERT INTO fact_order_item
    (
        order_id,
        amazon_order_id,
        order_item_id,

        seller_sku_id,

        asin,
        seller_sku,
        item_title,

        quantity_ordered,

        item_price_amount,
        item_tax_amount,
        promotion_discount_amount,

        item_revenue,

        currency,

        fulfillment_channel,

        source_system,

        created_at,
        updated_at
    )

    SELECT
        fo.id,

        s.amazon_order_id,
        s.order_item_id,

        NULL,

        s.asin,
        s.seller_sku,
        s.title,

        s.quantity_ordered,

        s.item_price_amount,
        s.item_tax_amount,
        s.promotion_discount_amount,

        COALESCE(s.item_price_amount, 0)
        + COALESCE(s.item_tax_amount, 0)
        - COALESCE(s.promotion_discount_amount, 0),

        s.item_price_currency,

        s.fulfillment_channel,

        'AMAZON_SP_API',

        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

    FROM stg_order_items_amazon s

    INNER JOIN fact_order fo
        ON fo.amazon_order_id = s.amazon_order_id

    WHERE s.processed = FALSE
      AND s.order_item_id IS NOT NULL
      AND s.order_item_id <> s.amazon_order_id
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(s.seller_sku), '') IS NOT NULL

    ON CONFLICT
    (
        amazon_order_id,
        order_item_id
    )

    DO UPDATE SET

        seller_sku = EXCLUDED.seller_sku,

        item_title = EXCLUDED.item_title,

        quantity_ordered = EXCLUDED.quantity_ordered,

        item_price_amount = EXCLUDED.item_price_amount,

        item_tax_amount = EXCLUDED.item_tax_amount,

        promotion_discount_amount = EXCLUDED.promotion_discount_amount,

        item_revenue = EXCLUDED.item_revenue,

        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;


    GET DIAGNOSTICS rows_processed = ROW_COUNT;


    UPDATE stg_order_items_amazon

    SET
        processed = TRUE,
        processed_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

    WHERE processed = FALSE;


    RETURN rows_processed;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.register_login_failure(p_key text, p_window_seconds integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v integer;
begin
  insert into public.login_attempts as la (key, failures, window_start)
  values (p_key, 1, now())
  on conflict (key) do update
    set failures = case when la.window_start < now() - make_interval(secs => p_window_seconds)
                        then 1 else la.failures + 1 end,
        window_start = case when la.window_start < now() - make_interval(secs => p_window_seconds)
                            then now() else la.window_start end
  returning failures into v;
  return v;
end $function$

name: reprocess_costs
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reprocess_costs(p_sku text, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_account_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(sku text, orders_updated bigint, cost_before numeric, cost_after numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_sku_id BIGINT;
  v_cost_atual NUMERIC;
BEGIN
  -- Busca o registro canônico do SKU (prioriza o da conta informada, depois qualquer um com conta)
  SELECT d.id, d.cost_product INTO v_sku_id, v_cost_atual
  FROM dim_seller_sku d
  WHERE d.seller_sku = p_sku
    AND (p_account_id IS NULL OR d.marketplace_account_id = p_account_id)
  ORDER BY d.marketplace_account_id NULLS LAST, d.id DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  IF NOT FOUND OR v_sku_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT p_sku, 0::BIGINT, 0::NUMERIC, 0::NUMERIC;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE fact_order_item foi
    SET cost_product = v_cost_atual,
        cost_status = 'ok',
        updated_at = now()
    FROM fact_order fo
    WHERE foi.amazon_order_id::text = fo.amazon_order_id::text
      AND foi.seller_sku_id = v_sku_id
      AND fo.purchase_date >= p_from
      AND fo.purchase_date < (p_to + INTERVAL '1 day')
      AND (foi.cost_product IS DISTINCT FROM v_cost_atual OR foi.cost_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'ok')
    RETURNING foi.cost_product AS novo_custo
  )
  SELECT p_sku, COUNT(*)::BIGINT, v_cost_atual, v_cost_atual
  FROM updated;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.upsert_orders_batch(p_orders jsonb)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  inserted INTEGER := 0;
  item JSONB;
BEGIN
  FOR item IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_orders)
  LOOP
    INSERT INTO orders_amazon (
      order_id, created_time, last_updated_time, programs, marketplace_id,
      marketplace_name, channel_name, condition, amount, currency_code,
      asin, seller_sku, title, order_item_id, quantity_ordered,
      alias_id, alias_type, fulfillment_channel, canal_logistica
    ) VALUES (
      item->>'order_id',
      NULLIF(item->>'created_time', '')::TIMESTAMPTZ,
      NULLIF(item->>'last_updated_time', '')::TIMESTAMPTZ,
      item->>'programs',
      item->>'marketplace_id',
      item->>'marketplace_name',
      item->>'channel_name',
      item->>'condition',
      (item->>'amount')::NUMERIC,
      item->>'currency_code',
      item->>'asin',
      item->>'seller_sku',
      item->>'title',
      item->>'order_item_id',
      (item->>'quantity_ordered')::INTEGER,
      item->>'alias_id',
      item->>'alias_type',
      item->>'fulfillment_channel',
      item->>'canal_logistica'
    )
    ON CONFLICT (order_item_id) DO UPDATE SET
      order_id = EXCLUDED.order_id,
      created_time = EXCLUDED.created_time,
      last_updated_time = EXCLUDED.last_updated_time,
      programs = EXCLUDED.programs,
      marketplace_id = EXCLUDED.marketplace_id,
      marketplace_name = EXCLUDED.marketplace_name,
      channel_name = EXCLUDED.channel_name,
      condition = EXCLUDED.condition,
      amount = EXCLUDED.amount,
      currency_code = EXCLUDED.currency_code,
      asin = EXCLUDED.asin,
      seller_sku = EXCLUDED.seller_sku,
      title = EXCLUDED.title,
      quantity_ordered = EXCLUDED.quantity_ordered,
      alias_id = EXCLUDED.alias_id,
      alias_type = EXCLUDED.alias_type,
      fulfillment_channel = EXCLUDED.fulfillment_channel,
      canal_logistica = EXCLUDED.canal_logistica;

    inserted := inserted + 1;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN inserted;
END;
$function$

WITH actual_orders AS (
         SELECT foi.amazon_order_id,
            d.seller_sku,
            d.product_name,
            min(fe.posted_date) FILTER (WHERE (fe.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['ItemCharge'::text, 'ItemFee'::text]))) AS posted_date,
            fo.purchase_date AS order_purchase_date,
            fo.order_status,
            COALESCE(fo.fulfillment_channel, foi.fulfillment_channel) AS order_fulfillment_channel,
            fo.sales_channel,
            fo.account_id,
            foi.order_item_id,
            foi.quantity_ordered,
            foi.item_price_amount,
            foi.item_revenue,
            COALESCE(foi.promotion_discount_amount, (0)::numeric) AS promotion_discount,
            COALESCE(foi.cost_product, d.cost_product, (0)::numeric) AS cost_product,
            foi.cost_status,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ((fe.event_type = 'ItemCharge'::text) AND (fe.charge_or_fee_type = 'Principal'::text)) THEN fe.amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS principal,
            (0)::numeric AS shipping_charge,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ((fe.event_type = 'ItemCharge'::text) AND (fe.charge_or_fee_type = 'Tax'::text)) THEN fe.amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS tax,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ((fe.event_type = 'ItemFee'::text) AND (fe.charge_or_fee_type = 'FBAPerUnitFulfillmentFee'::text)) THEN fe.amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS fba_fee,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ((fe.event_type = 'ItemFee'::text) AND (fe.charge_or_fee_type = 'Commission'::text)) THEN fe.amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS commission,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (fe.event_type = 'ItemFee'::text) THEN fe.amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS total_item_fees,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ((fe.event_type = 'ServiceFee'::text) AND (fe.charge_or_fee_type = 'MFNPostageFee'::text)) THEN fe.amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS mfn_postage_fee_actual,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN ((fe.event_type = 'ServiceFee'::text) AND (fe.charge_or_fee_type = 'MFNShippingChargeback'::text)) THEN fe.amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS mfn_shipping_chargeback,
            'actual'::text AS fee_source
           FROM (((fact_order_item foi
             JOIN fact_order fo ON (((foi.amazon_order_id)::text = (fo.amazon_order_id)::text)))
             LEFT JOIN dim_seller_sku d ON ((foi.seller_sku_id = d.id)))
             LEFT JOIN financial_events fe ON (((fe.amazon_order_id = (foi.amazon_order_id)::text) AND (fe.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['ItemCharge'::text, 'ItemFee'::text, 'ServiceFee'::text])))))
          GROUP BY foi.amazon_order_id, d.seller_sku, d.product_name, fo.purchase_date, fo.order_status, COALESCE(fo.fulfillment_channel, foi.fulfillment_channel), fo.sales_channel, fo.account_id, foi.order_item_id, foi.quantity_ordered, foi.item_price_amount, foi.item_revenue, foi.promotion_discount_amount, COALESCE(foi.cost_product, d.cost_product, (0)::numeric), foi.cost_status

            WHEN (((ao.order_fulfillment_channel)::text = ANY (ARRAY['DBA'::text, 'MFN'::text])) AND ((ao.item_price_amount / (NULLIF(ao.quantity_ordered, 0))::numeric) <= 30.00)) THEN ('-4.50'::numeric * (ao.quantity_ordered)::numeric)
            WHEN (((ao.order_fulfillment_channel)::text = ANY (ARRAY['DBA'::text, 'MFN'::text])) AND ((ao.item_price_amount / (NULLIF(ao.quantity_ordered, 0))::numeric) <= 79.00)) THEN ('-6.75'::numeric * (ao.quantity_ordered)::numeric)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS mfn_postage_fee,

    ((((ao.principal + ao.commission) + ao.fba_fee) +
        CASE

            WHEN (((ao.order_fulfillment_channel)::text = ANY (ARRAY['DBA'::text, 'MFN'::text])) AND ((ao.item_price_amount / (NULLIF(ao.quantity_ordered, 0))::numeric) <= 30.00)) THEN ('-4.50'::numeric * (ao.quantity_ordered)::numeric)
            WHEN (((ao.order_fulfillment_channel)::text = ANY (ARRAY['DBA'::text, 'MFN'::text])) AND ((ao.item_price_amount / (NULLIF(ao.quantity_ordered, 0))::numeric) <= 79.00)) THEN ('-6.75'::numeric * (ao.quantity_ordered)::numeric)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END) - (ao.promotion_discount * (ao.quantity_ordered)::numeric)) AS net_revenue,
    (((((ao.principal + ao.commission) + ao.fba_fee) +
        CASE
            WHEN (ao.mfn_postage_fee_actual <> (0)::numeric) THEN ao.mfn_postage_fee_actual
            WHEN (((ao.order_fulfillment_channel)::text = ANY (ARRAY['DBA'::text, 'MFN'::text])) AND ((ao.item_price_amount / (NULLIF(ao.quantity_ordered, 0))::numeric) <= 30.00)) THEN ('-4.50'::numeric * (ao.quantity_ordered)::numeric)

            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END) - (ao.promotion_discount * (ao.quantity_ordered)::numeric)) - (ao.cost_product * (ao.quantity_ordered)::numeric)) AS gross_profit,
    ao.fee_source
